title: Father in Suit with Little Son on Porch Steps, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black and white outdoor family portrait capturing a father and his toddler son posed on the front porch steps of a residential home. The father, wearing dark-rimmed eyeglasses, a dark tailored suit, and tie, kneels down while balancing his young son on his knee. The toddler is smartly dressed in a light-colored collared shirt, small bow tie, shorts, and white lace-up shoes. A white paneled front door, dark window shutter, and flowering bush frame this affectionate suburban family moment.
